checks: Empty startup, 256 cells, sandboxed table IPC and no ROM tools or APIs
8-bit Unicode/tokens save through the real preload and IPC to UTF-8 on disk
Undo/Redo plus Cancel and Save decisions protect unsaved changes on New
Opening restores saved values; malformed files leave the current table intact
8-bit alphabet and numbers fill automatically from the chosen cell and undo in one step
16-bit page 81 saves and reopens Japanese characters with full keys and 256 rendered cells
Character catalog changes only the selected 16-bit cell
16-bit uppercase, lowercase and numeric sequences preserve full addresses and Undo/Redo
Overwrite requires confirmation and overflow at FFFF changes nothing
Ctrl+F selects a full 16-bit address and F1 opens the shortcuts dialog
Cancel on window close preserves the dirty document
note: Native and renderer dialog choices are automated; application UI, sandbox, preload, IPC and filesystem are real.
